content: Baabiloone Gimbe
Biitta bollan diza asi wuri koyro issi doonanne issi qaala haasayees.
Asay arshey mokkiza bagga simmidi bishe Sana7oore geetettiza biittan issi dembaso demmidi heen uttides.
Istti issoy issaa, «Haa yiite; xuube medhdhidi ane taman xuuggoos» giidi istta shuchcha gishshas xuube, urqqa gishshas shida
ekkidi, «Haa yiite! Nu sunth xeygisanaassinne qasse nuni ha biitta ubbaa bollan laalettontta mala issi gita katamanne xeeray pude salo gakkiza issi gimbe ane keexxoos» gida.
Gido attiin GODAY asay keexxida gita katamazanne gimbeza beyanaas duge wodhdhidi,
«Hekko istti issi asa! Qasse istti wurikka issi qaalan haasayeettes; istti ha7i hayssa ooso oykkidaappe guye, istti baas ooththanaas qoppidayssa istta digganay deenna.
Haa yiite! Ane nu duge wodhdhidi istti issoy issaa qaala erontta mala istta qaala walakkoos» gides.
Hessa gishshas GODAY istta hessafe biitta ubbaa bollan laalliin istti he gita katama ooththizayssa aggaagida.
GODAY biitta asaa qaalaa heen walakkida gishshas he katamaya Baabile
geetettadus. GODAY istta hessafe biitta ubbaa bollan laallides.
Seeme Zereth
Seeme zereththi hayssafe kaallidi xaafettidayssa; dhayssa haaththi simmiin nam7u layththafe guye Seemes layththay 100 gidiin Seemey Arfaakiside yelides.
Seemey Arfaakiside yelidaappe guye 500 layth de7ides; hara attuma naytakka macca naytakka yelides.
Arfaakisidey 35
layth de7idi Sheelahe yelides;
Arfaakisidey Sheelahe yelidaappe guye 403 layth de7ides; hara attuma naytanne macca naytakka yelides.
Sheelahey 30
layth de7idi Eboore yelides;
Sheelahey Eboore yelidaappe guye 403 layth de7ides; hara attuma naytanne macca nayta yelides.
Eboorey heedzdzu tammanne oyddu
layth de7idi Peeleege yelides;
Eboorey Peeleege yelidaappe guye 430 layth de7ides; hara attuma naytanne macca nayta yelides.
Peeleegey 30 layth de7idi Era7e yelides;
Peeleegey Era7e yelidaappe guye 209 layth de7ides; hara attuma naytanne macca nayta yelides.
Era7ey 32 layth de7idi Saruge yelides;
Era7ey Saruge yelidaappe guye 207 layth de7ides; hara attuma naytanne macca nayta yelides.
Sarugey 30 layth de7idi Naakoore yelides;
Sarugey Naakoore yelidaappe guye 200 layth de7ides; hara attuma naytanne macca nayta yelides.
Naakoorey 29
layth de7idi Taara yelides.
Naakoorey Taara yelidaappe guye 119 layth de7ides; hara attuma naytanne macca nayta yelides.
Taaray 70 layth de7idi Abraame, Naakoorenne Haaraane yelides.
Taara Zereth
Taara yeletay hayssafe kaallidi xaafettidayssa; Taaray Abraame, Naakoorenne Haaraane yeliin Haaraaney Looxe yelides.
Haaraaney ba aaway Taaray paxa dishin ba yelettida Kaladaaweta biittan Uure geetettiza gita katamaan hayqqides.
Abraameynne Naakoorey nam7ayka machchida; Abraame machchey sunththi Soora; qasse Naakoore machchey sunththi Milka; Milkay Haaraane naa; Haaraaney Milkissinne Yiskaanissi aawa.
Sooray maynne; izis nay baawa.

Taaray ba naa Abraame, ba naaza Haaraane naa Looxenne ba naa Abraame machcho Soora ekkidi keziin istti issife Kanaane biitta baanaas Uure geetettiza Kaladaaweta katamappe dendida; gido attiin istti Kaaraane geetettiza katama gakkanaas biidi heen de7ida.
Taaray 205 layth de7idi Kaaraanen hayqqides.
